canonicalSource.description: Approved ChatGPT SYNC concept: luminous friendly AI host above a human friend group using phones in a cobalt/cyan room with chat bubbles, prediction bars and handwritten prediction notes.
canonicalSource.authorityRule: This source outranks current implementation assets for graphic-fidelity decisions until an approved successor is explicitly accepted.

recognitionTest: With copy hidden, the surface must still read as the cobalt AI-hosted social prediction world and remain clearly distinct from Live Site arena spectacle and Lovable human-chemistry lounge.
allowedTransformations: optimized vector revisions that preserve AI host plus human group
prediction graphics that do not obscure faces
rollback: Remove chat-v2.css, chat-v2.js, chat-social-scene-v2.svg and their index references to return to the previous Chat Edition presentation without changing gameplay authority.
truthBoundary: This candidate materially improves asset-level composition but does not claim pixel-level fidelity to the founder-approved external concept because the original approved binary is not repository-owned for direct comparison.
